tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create a wide ONE-row THREE-column grid of EXACTLY THREE full-body poses, every cell equal size. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted Ring Tailed Lemur shown in image1; identity features: 白い顔と黒い眼周り・大耳・一本の白黒輪尾. Preserve the reference’s large head, exact torso LENGTH and WIDTH, short upright two-legged body and two arm-like forepaws. Never shorten/slim the torso or enlarge the head relative to it. Keep exactly the existing2 arms,2 legs and existing tail/horns/ears; do not create a tail on a tailless reference. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required left-to-right order of THREE ONLY: 1 CHEER: Gentle pleased grounded celebration, two connected forepaws comfortably lifted, smiling closed eyes allowed; no jump or new props. 2 SPECIES_A: Curl only the end of the single reference tail a little more; keep the mascot stance and arms near neutral. 3 SPECIES_B: The same tail tip relaxes part-way back toward its original curve; no change to body scale or foot support. No other pose or extra neutral. Full shapes with plenty of true transparent margins and gutters. 
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.

original_output.availability: Historical tool location; bundled saved_output is the usable original.

record_scope: Selected source only. Historical candidate/QA files are source-workspace history, not bundled dependencies.
